_about: Roadmap progress. Each phase is a weighted list of items; weight is the item's share of that phase's effort, done its completion from 0 to 1. kind 'measured' means tools/progress.py computes done from the repository (or a census figure it records here); 'estimate' means a judgement, with its evidence. See docs/progress.md.

P1.item: Translation, lockstep, routes and the emulated PC (roadmap Phase 1 'Done')
P1.evidence: All 17 code files translated (89,276 instructions); instruction lockstep 0 mismatches over 5.7M states; 27 routes identical across engines; fidelity.py 1,210/1,210; housekeeping done.

P1.item: The picture against DOSBox, frame by frame
P1.evidence: 1,321 of 1,326 reference pictures exact, end drift +14 ms; 5 + 16 single-sample unmatched pictures remain.
Integration, MIDI parity and offline rendering done; independent reference PCM and a listening check open.
All 8 objective types and returns verified; independent GOG DOSBox cargo reproduction and wider generated-assignment coverage open.
Promotion, medals, tour ribbon and rank-3 retirement earned and paired; rank-6 'General, At Last!' branch open.
Keyboard/mouse/joystick paths exist and record sessions; no structured playtest of controls, saves and feel yet.
PIT control-word IRQ found and fixed; I/O slice suppression matched; exact retrace phase (the one-frame channel-3 note) and PLAYER's few-byte DAC gap open.
DBOPL default, mixer rounding fixed; intro waveform within ~0.5% RMS but not exact; speech and speaker need reference PCM.
